observations: Rossmann exact-GTIN page for 3574661798448 identifies Strength & Length Keratin Oil Shampoo 385 ml.
The cleanser base is Sodium Methyl Cocoyl Taurate, Decyl Glucoside, and Cocamidopropyl Betaine.
Hydrolyzed Keratin, Argania Spinosa Kernel Oil, Amodimethicone, Guar Hydroxypropyltrimonium Chloride, and Hydrogenated Castor Oil create the main repair/smoothing architecture.
